level_one.title: High King's Quest
level_one.description: Quest: Hit 50 Heroes with Basic Attacks. Quest: Participate in 5 Hero Takedowns. Quest: Gather 15 Regeneration Globes.  Reward: Completing a Quest grants 10 Base Attack Damage. Completing all 3 Quests grants an additional 30 Base Attack Damage.

level_four.title: Twin Blades of Fury
level_four.description: Basic Attacks reduce Heroic Strike's cooldown by an additional 7 seconds, and increase Varian's Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.  Passive: Attack Speed increased by 100%. Passive: Base Attack Damage reduced by 25%.

level_seven.title: Victory Rush
level_seven.description: Every 30 seconds, Varian's next Basic Attack will heal him for 350 (+4% per level) Health. When a nearby enemy Minion or Monster dies, the cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.

level_ten.title: Shield Wall
level_ten.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

level_thirteen.title: Mortal Strike
level_thirteen.description: Heroes hit by Heroic Strike receive 40% reduced healing for 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Banner of Stormwind
level_sixteen.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 25% increased Movement Speed to nearby allied Heroes. Lasts 12 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Frenzy
level_twenty.description: Twin Blades of Fury increases Heroic Strike damage by an additional 25%, and Basic Attacks increase his Movement Speed by an additional 10%.

level_one.title: Lion's Maw
level_one.description: Quest: Every time Lion's Fang hits a Hero, increase its damage by 7, up to 175.  Reward: After hitting 25 Heroes, the Slow is increased to 50% and its duration is increased to 2 seconds.

level_four.title: Taunt
level_four.description: Silence a target Hero and force them to attack Varian for 1.25 seconds.  Passive: Maximum Health and Health Regeneration increased by 40%.

level_seven.title: Lionheart
level_seven.description: Increase Lion's Fang's healing from Heroes by 75%.

level_ten.title: Shield Wall
level_ten.description: Parry grants Protected, preventing all incoming damage while active. Additionally, Parry's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds, but it loses 1 charge.

level_thirteen.title: Juggernaut
level_thirteen.description: Charge deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 4% of their maximum Health.

level_sixteen.title: Banner of Ironforge
level_sixteen.description: Activate to place a Banner that grants 20 Armor to nearby allied Heroes, reducing damage taken by 20%. Lasts 12 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Demoralizing Shout
level_twenty.description: Activate to demoralize nearby enemy Heroes, reducing damage they deal by 40% for 5 seconds.  Each time an enemy Hero affected by Demoralizing Shout deals damage to a Hero, reduce its cooldown and Parry's cooldown by 5%.

level_one.title: Fatal Wounds
level_one.description: While at maximum stacks, Blood Rage's bleed deals 50% additional damage to enemy Heroes under 50% Health.

level_four.title: Ensnaring Swing
level_four.description: The primary target of Revolving Sweep is Slowed by 60% while Qhira is attached to them. Secondary targets hit by Revolving Sweep's swing are Slowed by 40% for 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Healmonger
level_seven.description: If Blood Rage damages an enemy Hero below 50% Health, it heals for an additional 210 (+4% per level) Health.

level_ten.title: Unrelenting Strikes
level_ten.description: Deal 44 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies every 0.5 seconds for 2.5 seconds as your sword grows outward. Upon expiring, deal 160 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemy Heroes and Stun them for 1.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Pulsing Pain
level_thirteen.description: Each additional enemy Hero hit by Revolving Sweep causes the primary target to take an additional 135 (+4% per level) damage.

level_sixteen.title: Lingering Ailment
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Revolving Sweep or by Grappling Hook have their Armor reduced by 35 for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Backlash
level_one.description: When Bone Armor expires, nearby enemy Heroes take damage equal to 12% of their maximum Health.

level_four.title: Jailors
level_four.description: Bone Prison spawns 2 Skeletal Warriors.  These do not count towards Xul's Raise Skeleton maximum.  Quest: Spawn 80 Skeletal Warriors.  Reward: While fixating on an enemy, Skeletal Warriors gain 25% Movement and Attack Speed.

level_seven.title: Trag'Oul's Essence
level_seven.description: Every time a Skeletal Warrior attacks an enemy, restore 0.5% of Xul's maximum Health and 0.2% of his maximum Mana.

level_ten.title: Poison Nova
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, release poisonous missiles that deal 630 (+4% per level) damage to all enemies hit over 10 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Echoes of Death
level_thirteen.description: Spectral Scythe spawns 2 additional scythes next to the first after 1.5 seconds, dealing 40% damage.

level_sixteen.title: Decrepify
level_sixteen.description: Enemy Heroes that are damaged by Spectral Scythe or Skeletal Warriors are Slowed by 30% for 2.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Mortal Wound
level_twenty.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Spectral Scythe receive 75% less healing for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Pressurized Glands
level_one.description: Increases the range of Symbiote's Spike Burst by 25% and decreases the cooldown by 1 second.

level_four.title: Adrenal Overload
level_four.description: Heroic Symbiote hosts gain 25% increased Attack Speed.

level_seven.title: Calldown: MULE
level_seven.description: Activate to calldown a Mule that repairs Structures, one at a time, near target point for 40 seconds, healing for 90 Health every 1 second.

level_ten.title: Ultimate Evolution
level_ten.description: Clone target allied Hero and control it for 20 seconds. Abathur has perfected the clone, granting it 20% Spell Power, 20% bonus Attack Damage, and 10% bonus Movement Speed. Cannot use their Heroic Ability.

level_thirteen.title: Soma Transference
level_thirteen.description: Symbiote's Spike Burst heals the host for 64 (+4% per level) Health per enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Adrenaline Boost
level_sixteen.description: Symbiote's Carapace increases the Movement Speed of the target by 40% for 3.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Hivemind
level_twenty.description: Symbiote creates an additional Symbiote on a nearby allied Hero.  This Symbiote mimics the commands of the first, but does half damage and Shielding.
